contentSafetySummary: read-heavy-06: Audit localized article caching and HTML rendering boundaries

cacheAndXssFindings.statement: locale affects the fetch but is omitted from queryKey, so cached content can cross locales for the same slug.
ArticleBody injects raw HTML without any visible sanitization boundary.

preciseCitations.excerpt: return useQuery({ queryKey: ['article', slug], queryFn: () => fetch('/api/articles/' + slug + '?locale=' + locale).then(r => r.json()) });
